## Source inspected
The public PDF was read on 20 September 2026. It is a finding aid. It does **not** reproduce the ECPM manual. A printed publication year and place were not confirmed beyond the host filename and the date range of cited works.
:::

## Annotation

The entry that grounds the ECPM wanted record, quoted in full as it appears:

> BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society  
> “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model: Skill Development Manual for Consumers of Home Support Services”, BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, 1990  
> A training manual that includes 5 modules intended to empower consumers to act as effective employers (52 pages plus appendices)

The same bibliography lists a June 1997 BCCPD individualized-funding conference whose annotation mentions “the Choices in Support for Independent Living Program” (wording *Choices in Support*, not *Choice in Supports*). That conference report was not recovered in this pass.

The bibliography does **not** list *Keys on Freedom*, a Creekview evaluation, or a 1994 ECPM revision.
